note: Snapshots of public datasets exactly as published. No values in this directory are modelled, imputed or edited by this project.

sources.label: Census TIGER 2020 ZCTA Boundaries (DE)
sources.dataset: TIGER/Line Cartographic Boundary File - 2020 ZCTA (cb_2020_us_zcta520_500k), clipped to Delaware
sources.access: Python client (pygris) over the Census TIGER web service
sources.note: Every attribute column the TIGER ZCTA shapefile ships with, geometry dropped so it can be archived as CSV. Clipped to the Delaware state boundary and restricted to ZCTAs whose centroid is inside Delaware AND whose ZIP is a Delaware ZIP (197/198/199). Both filters are required: the centroid test alone keeps border ZCTAs belonging to MD/PA/NJ.

sources.label: Census TIGER 2020 County Boundaries (DE)
sources.dataset: TIGER/Line Cartographic Boundary File - 2020 counties (cb_2020_us_county_500k), Delaware
sources.access: Python client (pygris) over the Census TIGER web service
sources.note: All 3 Delaware counties; source of County_FIPS / County_Name in the master.

sources.label: Census ACS 2024 5-Year Profile (ZCTA)
sources.dataset: American Community Survey 5-Year Data Profile (DP02 / DP03 / DP05)
sources.geography: ZCTA (Delaware rows of a national response)
sources.note: API variable codes retained (no renaming). 33,772 ZCTAs were returned nationwide; the snapshot keeps the Delaware rows used by the pipeline.

sources.label: CDC BRFSS 2024 Prevalence (DE, state level)
sources.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.dataset: Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System - Prevalence Data (Socrata resource dttw-5yxu)
sources.geography: State (Delaware) - broadcast onto ZCTA rows downstream
sources.note: Byte-for-byte copy of the CDC Socrata CSV response (no re-encoding, no column renaming). This is a STATE-level survey, so every row here describes Delaware as a whole - not an individual ZCTA.

sources.label: County Health Rankings 2025 (DE counties)
sources.publisher: County Health Rankings & Roadmaps (Univ. of Wisconsin Population Health Institute)
sources.dataset: 2025 County Health Rankings Data v4 (`Select Measure Data` + `Additional Measure Data` sheets, merged on FIPS)
sources.vintage: 2025 release (clinical-care source year 2022; see Sources & Years sheets)
sources.geography: County (Kent, New Castle, Sussex) - broadcast onto ZCTA rows downstream
sources.license: Free for public use with attribution (CHR&R / UW PHI)
sources.note: Workbook sheets 'Select Measure Data' + 'Additional Measure Data' merged on FIPS, every measure column kept, Delaware counties only (FIPS 10001/10003/10005). The two header rows the publisher ships are joined with '__'; no values are altered or rounded.

sources.label: CDC PLACES 2024 Place-Level (DE cities)
sources.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.dataset: PLACES: Local Data for Better Health - place/city release (Socrata eav7-hnsx)
sources.note: Untouched API rows - one row per place x measure with the publisher's own field names. PLACES publishes place/city, county, census-tract and ZCTA files as SEPARATE datasets; this endpoint is the place/city release.

sources.label: HRSA AHRF 2024-2025 (DE counties, provider supply)
sources.publisher: Health Resources & Services Administration (HRSA), U.S. Dept. of Health & Human Services
sources.dataset: Area Health Resources Files (AHRF) 2024-2025 CSV release - health professional (AHRF2025hp) + population (AHRF2025pop)
sources.vintage: 2024-2025 release (counts carry per-column vintage suffixes, e.g. _23)
sources.access: Direct .zip file download - no login, no data-use agreement
sources.note: Delaware county rows (FIPS 10001, 10003, 10005) from the 'AHRF2025hp.csv' health-professional file joined to 'AHRF2025pop.csv' on fips_st_cnty. Health-professional columns carry the publisher's own names and vintage suffix (e.g. md_nf_prim_care_pc_excl_rsdnt_23); population columns are prefixed 'pop_' so the two files' overlapping short names stay distinct. Values are exactly as published - AHRF suppresses small counts, so blanks mean 'suppressed', not zero.

sources.label: CDC PLACES 2024 ZCTA-Level (DE chronic disease & prevention)
sources.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.dataset: PLACES: Local Data for Better Health - ZCTA release (Socrata 4r2x-hcfq)
sources.geography: ZCTA (Delaware) - directly reported, NOT broadcast from a city file
sources.note: Untouched API rows - one row per ZCTA x measure with the publisher's own field names. 65 Delaware ZCTAs x 40 measures. This is the ZCTA release of PLACES, so the chronic-disease measures (diabetes, hypertension, asthma, COPD, depression, ...) are reported ON the ZCTAs rather than being borrowed from a city-level file and broadcast.
